core (φ : Probe E4) : F.action.momentum.diagonal (excitation F.action.operators (pinned F) φ) =
        μ.withDensity fun p => (probeWeight φ p : ℝ≥0∞)
    norm (φ ψ : Probe E4) : inner ℂ (excitation F.action.operators (pinned F) φ) (excitation F.action.operators (pinned F) ψ) =
        ∫ p, star (testPlus φ p)*testPlus ψ p ∂μ

proof_context.conclusion: `core` and `norm` say the diagonal spectral measure of the excitation `φ` is `μ.withDensity (probeWeight φ)` and `<excitation φ, excitation ψ> = ∫ star (testPlus φ) * testPlus ψ dμ`.

lemma traceSpectrum_exists : ∃! μ, TraceSpectrum F μ := by
    let P := F.realization.qt
    obtain ⟨Y,hY,h⟩ := ((Next.BOUNDARY.both (s:=F.room) F.phase P.letters F.realization.allWorld F.realization.chosen).2).reveals
    have he := (h F.action.J P.induced).2
    rw [hY] at he
    let v := pinned F
    let B := Y.bits
    let μ := spectralMeasure B v
    have hm : F.A.waves.Breathes := by rw [← hY]; exact Y.power.1
    have ht (s : ℝ) (hp : 0<s) : ∃ k:ℝ≥0, 0<k ∧ 2*(k:ℝ)=s :=
        ⟨⟨s/2,by positivity⟩,half_pos hp,by change 2*(s/2)=s; ring⟩
    have hμ : TraceSpectrum F μ := by
        refine ⟨spectral_temperate he hm _, energy_bounded he hm _, spectral_forward he hm F.realization.chosen.emerges P _, fun g => ?_, fun s hs=> ?_, fun s hs => ?_,
            mass_read he hm F.realization.chosen.emerges P _, norm_read he hm F.realization.chosen.emerges P _, surface_integral he hm F.realization.chosen.emerges _⟩
        · have hh := spectral_placed he hm F.realization.chosen.emerges P v g.dual
          unfold v at hh; rw [pinned_scalar,Lorentz.dual_involution] at hh; exact hh.symm
        · obtain ⟨k,hk,rfl⟩ := ht s hs
          unfold μ B; rw [damp he _ k hk]; infer_instance
        obtain ⟨k,hk,rfl⟩ := ht s hs
        unfold μ B; rw [continuation F hk,pair_restricted he _ k hk,damp he _ k hk]; simp [v]
    exact ⟨μ,hμ,fun ν h => h.unique hμ⟩

proof_context.conclusion: There is a unique `μ` with `TraceSpectrum F μ`, taken as the spectral measure of the pinned vector.

lemma weights_injective (μ ν : Measure E4) (hw : ∀ f : Probe E4, (μ.withDensity fun p => (probeWeight f p : ℝ≥0∞)) =
    ν.withDensity fun p => (probeWeight f p : ℝ≥0∞)) : μ = ν := by
    ext A ha
    let D (m:ℕ) := A ∩ closedBall (0:E4) (m:ℝ)
    have he : ⋃ m, D m=A := by simp [D, ← inter_iUnion,iUnion_closedBall_nat]
    have ht (m) : μ (D m)=ν (D m) := by
        obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := probe_one m
        rw [← local_weight hf μ (ha.inter isClosed_closedBall.measurableSet) inter_subset_right,
            ← local_weight hf ν (ha.inter isClosed_closedBall.measurableSet) inter_subset_right,hw]
    have hm : Monotone D := fun i j hj => inter_subset_inter_right A (closedBall_subset_closedBall (Nat.cast_le.mpr hj))
    refine tendsto_nhds_unique_of_eventuallyEq (f:=fun i => μ (D i)) (g:=fun i => ν (D i)) (l:=atTop) ?_ ?_ (Eventually.of_forall ht)
    · simpa only [← Function.comp_def,he] using tendsto_measure_iUnion_atTop (μ := μ) hm
    · simpa only [← Function.comp_def,he] using tendsto_measure_iUnion_atTop (μ := ν) hm

proof_context.conclusion: A measure on `E4` is determined by its weighted measures for all test functions `probeWeight f`, by exhausting with balls where a test has weight one.
